notes.title: [Developer Notes] Happy 1st Anniversary!
notes.content:
Hello, dreamers!

Today marks 1 year since the release of Eternal Dreamers! I would like to thank all players of the game for having a good time and their constant support, be it through encouragement or feedback! The game has steadily been growing since release at a pace my indie dev self can manage, so I thank everyone for their patience waiting for new updates!

Speaking of updates, where will the game be going from here? I've been hard at work at a large-scale update worthy of the anniversary, which is currently in its final development stages. Here is a preview of some of the things you can expect, subject to change throughout development:

New Sytem:
Advent Supplies
Allows players to summon characters, memoria and auxiliary items using a new currency called Dreamstones. This currency can be obtained both ingame and through microtransactions. To ensure nobody has to use the latter, the game will grant currency just for playing!

It has long been my wish to make all characters obtainable for those that love playing the game, but just cannot afford to spend on it. The option to support the game will remain, but I hope this will let everyone enjoy these wonderful characters all the same!

On release, this system will replace all character-specific DLC. Pre-existing owners get to keep theirs of course!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761974/3d7094506b43120e68ec3494307afb54304274aa.png

New Equipment:
Memoria
A new equipment type obtained via Advent Supplies when repeatedly summoning the same character. Memoria reflect the essence of the character they represent, such as Reiketsu's boosting a character's evasion!


 Each character has their own Memoria with unique minor stat bonuses, however, these Memoria can be equipped by any one character
 Memoria can be amplified up to 5 or 10 times respectively by using 1x Memoria Dust per amplification
     -1x or 2x Memoria Dust can be obtained by recycling a Memoria depending on its rarity

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761974/cabfd99ccad910432d7ec0915c84a84dfd786f90.png

Class Rework
The vast amount of weapon types in the game has been received negatively by players that found no use for those they lacked characters for. This rework will do away with this negative by streamlining weapon types and reducing the total amount to 3 weapon types. This change will ensure that a newly obtained weapon can be used in a majority of cases.


 New weapon types will replace the old: MELEE, RANGED, TECH
 Weapons obtained prior to this update will remain with the player and their previous weapon type, being usable only on their respective character

Existing characters will be assigned as follows:

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]MELEE[/th]
        [th]RANGED[/th]
        [th]TECH[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Player, Marlon, Anna, Sylfie[/td]
        [td]Reiketsu, Natsume, ShirA.I., Shana[/td]
        [td]Forest, Monolith, Sakia, Faeris[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

From a development point of view, this rework will make it easier to introduce new characters with distinct playstyles and personalities, and on player side increase the amount of possible rare equipment and character combinations! I wonder (and fear) what kind of broken combos will be discovered!

New Character:
Shana
A trained Advent soldier with a deadpan attitude towards her work, Shana specialices in high damage output and speed. Shana will be making use of the RANGED weapon category.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761974/630e97083d26075715026b177e36bfce0d97fb13.png
Art by @Dakosito on Twitter! Go check them out!

And more...

 New items to hunt
 New fashion items
 Ability learning made easier than ever
 Individual character reworks
 Loads of general improvements
 ....


Those are only some of the highlights coming your way! I am excited to share more with you when the update goes live! Until then and to another year of dreaming! So long!

Your lovable newscaster, ShirA.I., offers her steady support to celebrate over 10000 players! Her mission to deliver news to all of humanity won’t be endangered by the Sudden Coma Phenomenon!

In order to allow for more visual customization of your characters, fashion items will be introduced! These items change the appearance of a given character in conversation, menu and combat. The socket system in its current iteration is a bit too rigid. Once an armor piece has been obtained, there isn’t much reason to keep hunting for more. notes.title: Developer Notes – April 2021
notes.content:
Hey, dreamers! 

Today, I’d like to share some of my work on the exciting content coming to the game soon. While the previous dev notes focused on upcoming new areas and announced dating sim elements, we’ll make another special announcement today!

New Class: Player

Whereas the player character was a faceless and mostly silent character so far, all of that will change with the introduction of a free new class, the Player themselves!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37761974/e29d4b9dae1984cf6d5fea71060da767ea2f7dbf.png
Work in Progress drawing of the Player

The Player will be a unique class that comes with all of its abilities out of the gate. To increase their level, the party will have to challenge this experienced war veteran and win in increasingly difficult fights.

The Player utilizes so-called marks left on opponents after each of her attacks. The next party member to attack a target afflicted will receive benefits in accordance with the mark. This class requires strategic thinking ahead and will be most efficient in a well-planned party composition.

Who is the Player?

With the introduction of the Player class, the character will receive a voice too. In the past, she was a renowned soldier, but a brutal war with Advent brought an end to her people. Woken by the very same conglomerate to help avert the looming crisis, she is well aware of her position as a hostage.

And so, despite her own complicated past with the Advent conglomerate, she will have to guide our party into a new future. Can she overcome her troubled feelings and somber past?

---------

While I cannot announce a set date for her release, the Player will release with the next update once ready. I hope you’re looking forward to a more engaging and personal story beginning with her introduction!

notes.title: Eternal Dreamers is going free-to-play!
notes.content:
After almost a year in Early Access, Eternal Dreamers is going free-to-play! What does that mean for buyers of the paid version and the game going forward? Everything is outlined below!

When is Eternal Dreamers going F2P?

The switch to F2P is expected to take place on January 11th

I bought/plan to buy the game before the change to F2P. What happens to my progress? Do I have to buy content I already paid for again?

Existing save states will remain functional (It is strongly suggested to start a new save state regardless)
Buyers of the paid version will receive all initially released DLC for free, covering all content that was part of the game before the change

What kind of downloadable content (DLC) will be available?

     -Anna, the Blood Driver
     -Sakia, the Manipulator
     -Faeris, the Illuminon
     -Natsume, the Hunter

How will the structure of the game and content releases change?

Outside of limiting free character availability, the structure of the game will remain unchanged
Planned content releases such as new areas will occur as before and be free for all players


We are incredibly excited for this change! Thank you for your support and see you next week!

notes.title: Update (December 4th)
notes.content:
Hohoho, fellow dreamers! A most merry Christmas season to all of you!

Today’s major update continues the expansion of the Tower and makes way for passive abilities for all classes!

Since its introduction, the Tower was meant to be a late-game activity testing the will and prowess of the player. However, the length of a session and lack of adequate rewards left them wondering if the time investment for the mode was justified. With the new scoring system, players are rewarded no matter how far they make it into the Tower, making every single trip worthwhile. In addition to this, the selection of exchange prizes has been greatly expanded, boosting various helpful items to choose from. Finally, players now may heal their party up to 3x times throughout a Tower session.

To further increase the growth potential of all characters, this update also introduces passive abilities for every class. These are powerful assets that will bring your party to the next level! In order to learn and level these abilities, the coaching system has been mildly revamped to revolve around them.

Changes and bug fixes can be found below:

Campaigns

Tower
